Thanks — this looks good. Quick confirmations on our side:

- Integration owner: Miguel Santos (APIs, sandbox connectivity)

Success criteria we need to see in the MAP:

Thanks Lauren — noted. Quick plan from Redwood evaluation side:

- Bench design: we'll run two tiers — (A) developer bench (50 labeled cases from Aisha) focused on precision/recall; (B) integration bench to validate latency and end-to-end request/response under a small load.
- Prompt ownership: CardioHealth to provide clinical prompts and expected outputs; Redwood to produce instrumentation prompts (edge cases, adversarial phrasing) and scoring scripts.
- Acceptance gates:
  - Stage 1 (Week 1): connectivity + sanity checks (pass/fail)
  - Stage 2 (Week 2–3): quality thresholds on developer bench (target: 88% top-1 accuracy for primary use-case)
  - Stage 3 (Week 4): integration stress run and documentation handoff

I've uploaded an initial bench worksheet to the shared Drive link; I've also filled the templates with a preliminary prompt roster (see benchmarks_template.xlsx). Action items:
- Marissa: take point on scoring scripts and runbook for repro steps.
- Rishi: capture infra SLO targets and define fallback policy for degraded throughput.
- Lauren: confirm the Friday alignment slot and own the MAP doc consolidation.

I'll circulate updated acceptance gates after I sync with Marissa this afternoon.

Best,
